rules.title: High 24-Hour Transaction Velocity
rules.description: Account executes 5 or more outbound transactions within a rolling 24-hour window.

rules.title: Severe Amount Z-Score Deviation
rules.description: Transaction amount exceeds 3.0 standard deviations above the customer's 90-day baseline mean.

rules.title: Impossible Travel Velocity Between Transactions
rules.description: Implied travel speed between consecutive geolocated events exceeds 800 km/h.

rules.title: Unrecognized High-Risk Device or Proxy
rules.description: Transaction originates from a new device fingerprint or anonymizing VPN/TOR exit node.

rules.title: Potential Structuring / Smurfing Pattern
rules.description: Multiple sub-threshold or round-dollar transfers clustered to evade reporting thresholds.

rules.title: Verified Benign Seasonal or Recurring Spend
rules.description: Minor variance within normal baseline bounds on a trusted device and consistent geography.
